card.name: Words about stopping, discarding, negating
card.fires_on: Words that express negation, stopping or throwing away in drug-label text, such as "Not" in "Not recommended", "mean" after "does not", "discontin", "discard" and "dispose of".

modes.label: Negation words
modes.description: "Not" or "mean" in statements saying something is not recommended or a negative result does not imply something.
modes.example: A negative result from a plasma specimen does not<< mean>> that the patient’s tumor is negative for

modes.label: Stopping or discarding
modes.description: Verbs about stopping a drug or throwing something away, such as discontinuing, discarding or disposing of.
